verses.5:26: قَالَ فَإِنَّهَا مُحَرَّمَةٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡۛ أَرۡبَعِينَ سَنَةࣰۛ يَتِيهُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ فَلَا تَأۡسَ عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ

meaning: The root تيه (tyh) primarily signifies wandering or going astray, often in a desert or wilderness, without a clear path or guidance.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
